broker:
한국투자증권 (Korea Investment & Securities), KIS Developers REST API. I re-checked everything independently against two primary sources.
(1) The official repo github.com/koreainvestment/open-trading-api, commit b4e6249 (2026-08-26), freshly cloned to /tmp/tmp.cupnRQgYT8/open-trading-api.
(2) The official KIS Developers portal JSON. Per-API detail comes from GET https://apiportal.koreainvestment.com/api/apis/public/detail?accessUrl=<path>, saved to /tmp/tmp.cupnRQgYT8/spec/*.json. The full raw catalog comes from GET https://apiportal.koreainvestment.com/api/apis/public?page=0&size=1000 (response header X-Total-Count: 427), saved to /tmp/tmp.cupnRQgYT8/all.json.
The portal's own search endpoint (/api/apis/search/public/apis?keyword=) was used to tell published APIs from unpublished ones. When the repo and the portal disagree, I treat the portal as authoritative. No unofficial libraries were used. Repo code comments are cited as official-repo evidence, not as the portal spec.
auth:
Token issuance
- Prod: POST https://openapi.koreainvestment.com:9443/oauth2/tokenP
- Paper: POST https://openapivts.koreainvestment.com:29443/oauth2/tokenP (portal realDomain/virtualDomain; kis_devlp.yaml prod/vps)
- Body (JSON): {"grant_type":"client_credentials","appkey":<36 chars>,"appsecret":<180 chars>}
- Headers: the portal lists no req_h for tokenP. The official sample (kis_auth.py _base_headers) sends:
  - Content-Type: application/json
  - Accept: text/plain
  - charset: UTF-8
  - User-Agent: <my_agent from yaml>
- Response fields:
  - access_token (length 350)
  - token_type: "Bearer"
  - expires_in: seconds, numeric. The portal sample response shows 86400. The field description's example value is 7776000.
  - access_token_token_expired: "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"
- Portal resAuth: "access_token_token_expired":"2023-12-22 08:16:59","token_type":"Bearer","expires_in":86400

Lifetime (portal tokenP apiSummary and field description)
- Valid for 24 hours, on a one-issuance-per-day principle (1일 1회발급 원칙).
- The renewal cycle is 6 hours: a call within 6 hours returns the previous token.
- Since 2023-04-28, a re-request within a set time returns the previous token.
- Per the tokenP field description, 일반개인고객/일반법인고객 (individuals and general corporate customers) get 1 day. Only 제휴법인 (partner corporations) get 3 months, with a 1-year refresh token under the Authorization Code grant.
- Other APIs' authorization header description says loosely "법인 … 3개월" (corporations: 3 months). For an individual, the lifetime is 1 day either way.

Reissue frequency
- Repo README.md line 371, "토큰 오류 시" section: "토큰 재발급 - 1분당 1회 발급됩니다" (at most one reissue per minute).
- kis_auth.py comments: every issuance sends a KakaoTalk alert (발급시 알림톡 무조건 발송). This is a notification only; no user approval step was found.

Recommended caching (official sample)
- save_token/read_token write the token and "valid-date" (from access_token_token_expired) to ~/KIS/config/KIS<YYYYMMDD>.
- The token is reused while valid-date > now.
- reAuth() re-issues after 86400 s.

Revoke
- POST /oauth2/revokeP with JSON body {appkey, appsecret, token}.
- Response: {"code":200,"message":"접근토큰 폐기에 성공하였습니다"}

Headers for every data call (portal req_h and kis_auth._url_fetch)
- content-type: "application/json; charset=utf-8" (portal). The sample sends Content-Type application/json plus Accept/charset/User-Agent.
- authorization: "Bearer <access_token>"
- appkey, appsecret
- tr_id: per API
- custtype: "P". Portal: B = 법인 (corporate), P = 개인 (individual). The repo comment says P = 일반 (개인/법인) and B = 제휴사 (partner). Use P for a personal account. It is optional on inquire-balance and required on CTRP6548R/CTRGA011R/CTRP6010R.
- tr_cont: "" on the first call, "N" on the next page.
- _url_fetch rewrites a tr_id starting with T, J or C to a V prefix in paper mode.
- Corporate-only headers (personalseckey, seq_no, phone_number, ip_addr, gt_uid) are not needed.
account_selection:
No published account-list API
- Nothing in the repo lists accounts, and the portal search does not return one.
- The raw portal catalog does contain unpublished stubs with no fields and no HTTP method: 종합계좌계좌명조회[V1_일반-011] /uapi/general/v1/member/inquire-account-name, and the partner-only (제휴사)오픈API제휴계좌현황조회 /uapi/affl/requestCustList. They are not usable as documented.

Account parameters
- Account number format is 8-2. Send CANO (first 8 digits) and ACNT_PRDT_CD (last 2 digits) as query parameters on every account API.

Product codes (kis_devlp.yaml comments)
- 01: 종합계좌 (general brokerage)
- 03: 국내선물옵션 (domestic futures/options)
- 08: 해외선물옵션 (overseas futures/options)
- 22: 개인연금 (personal pension)
- 29: 퇴직연금 (retirement pension)
- The portal pension APIs use ACNT_PRDT_CD 29 and say 55 (DC가입자계좌) is not supported.
- inquire-account-balance: the repo docstring example is "19 or 21", the portal reqExample is "01", and the portal describes a 17-row layout for 21 accounts.
- period-rights: the example is "01 or 22".

Official sample config (~/KIS/config/kis_devlp.yaml)
- my_app / my_sec: prod keys
- paper_app / paper_sec: paper keys
- my_htsid: HTS ID
- my_acct_stock / my_acct_future / my_paper_stock / my_paper_future: 8-digit parts
- my_prod: 2-digit part
- my_agent: User-Agent
- changeTREnv maps product 01/22/29 to my_acct_stock and 03/08 to my_acct_future, all with the same appkey.
- Portal pension apiSummary: KIS Developers is issued per HTS ID (HTS ID에 반드시 연결되어있어야만 API 신청 및 앱정보 발급이 가능).

Pagination
- Response header tr_cont: "F" or "M" means more data; "D" or "E" means the last page.
- For the next page, send request header tr_cont "N" and echo the body ctx_area_fk100/ctx_area_nk100 back as CTX_AREA_FK100/CTX_AREA_NK100.
- Overseas-price period-rights uses CTX_AREA_FK50/NK50.
- The unpublished deposit-withdrawal entry uses CTX_AREA_NK30 + CTX_AREA_FK100.
- Some APIs say tr_cont paging is not available ("tr_cont를 이용한 다음조회 불가 API"): CTRGT011R and HHKDB669102C0.

endpoints.purpose: Domestic stock balance (주식잔고조회[v1_국내주식-006]): per-holding valuation plus an account summary with cash (T, D+1, D+2) and total valuation
headers: custtype: P (portal marks it optional here)
tr_cont: '' on the first call, 'N' on the next page
endpoints.request:
Query parameters:
- CANO: 8 digits
- ACNT_PRDT_CD: 2 digits
- AFHR_FLPR_YN: portal says N = KRX정규장종가 (KRX regular-session close), X = NXT, Y = KRX+NXT 통합시세 (combined price). The repo docstring says N default, Y 시간외단일가 (after-hours single price), X NXT. Use N.
- OFL_YN: ""
- INQR_DVSN: the portal lists only 01 = 대출일별 (by loan date). The repo docstring adds 02 = 종목별 (by stock), and backtester, strategy_builder and examples_user all send "02". loan_dt is only filled with 01.
- UNPR_DVSN: 01
- FUND_STTL_ICLD_YN: N or Y (include fund settlements)
- FNCG_AMT_AUTO_RDPT_YN: N
- PRCS_DVSN: 00 = include previous day's trades, 01 = exclude
- CTX_AREA_FK100, CTX_AREA_NK100: "" on the first call
endpoints.response_fields:
output1 (array, one row per holding; strings, KRW):
- pdno, prdt_name
- trad_dvsn_name: 매수매도구분 (buy/sell type); sample values 현금 (cash) and 자기융자 (margin loan)
- bfdy_buy_qty, bfdy_sll_qty, thdt_buyqty, thdt_sll_qty
- hldg_qty: quantity held
- ord_psbl_qty
- pchs_avg_pric: 매입금액/보유수량 (pchs_amt / hldg_qty)
- pchs_amt: purchase amount
- prpr: current price
- evlu_amt: valuation
- evlu_pfls_amt: 평가금액-매입금액 (evlu_amt - pchs_amt)
- evlu_pfls_rt: P&L %
- evlu_erng_rt: 미사용항목, always 0
- loan_dt, loan_amt, stln_slng_chgs, expd_dt, fltt_rt, bfdy_cprs_icdc, item_mgna_rt_name, grta_rt_name, sbst_pric, stck_loan_unpr

output2 (array with one summary object; KRW):
- dnca_tot_amt (예수금총금액): portal says only "예수금" (deposit)
- nxdy_excc_amt (익일정산금액): D+1 예수금
- prvs_rcdl_excc_amt (가수도정산금액): D+2 예수금
- cma_evlu_amt
- bfdy_buy_amt, thdt_buy_amt, bfdy_sll_amt, thdt_sll_amt
- nxdy_auto_rdpt_amt, d2_auto_rdpt_amt
- bfdy_tlex_amt, thdt_tlex_amt: previous-day and same-day costs (제비용)
- tot_loan_amt
- scts_evlu_amt (유가평가금액): securities valuation
- tot_evlu_amt (총평가금액): 유가증권 평가금액 합계금액 + D+2 예수금 (securities valuation total + D+2 deposit)
- nass_amt (순자산금액): net assets; no portal description
- fncg_gld_auto_rdpt_yn
- pchs_amt_smtl_amt: purchase total
- evlu_amt_smtl_amt: 유가증권 평가금액 합계금액 (securities valuation total)
- evlu_pfls_smtl_amt: valuation P&L total
- tot_stln_slng_chgs
- bfdy_tot_asst_evlu_amt (전일총자산평가금액): previous day's total asset valuation
- asst_icdc_amt (자산증감액): asset change amount
- asst_icdc_erng_rt: portal says "데이터 미제공" (not provided)

Body page cursors: ctx_area_fk100, ctx_area_nk100.
endpoints.pagination: 50 rows per call in real, 20 in paper. The response header tr_cont F/M means more pages: resend with tr_cont=N and the body ctx_area_fk100/nk100. The repo sample recurses up to max_depth=10 with ka.smart_sleep() between pages. It concatenates output2 from every page, so output2 rows repeat; keep one.

- cma_evlu_amt
- dncl_amt (예수금액)
- tot_sbst_amt
- thdt_rcvb_amt (당일미수금액)

rate_limits:
Per-appkey REST limit for prod
- The official repo's legacy/rest/*.py scripts (get_interest_stocks_price.py, get_ovsstk_chart_price.py, get_ovsfut_chart_price.py) carry the comment "유량제한 예방 (REST: 1초당 20건 제한)", i.e. a REST limit of 20 calls per second. This is repo code commentary, not a portal statement.
- The portal JSON for the 427 APIs contains no personal per-second number.

Code spacing
- examples_llm/kis_auth.py and backtester/kis_auth.py both try to set _smartSleep to 0.05 (prod) or 0.5 (paper) inside changeTREnv. They do it without `global _smartSleep`, so the module value 0.1 s stays in effect.
- In practice both the examples' smart_sleep() between pages and the backtester's _url_fetch minimum spacing are 0.1 s (about 10 calls/s). The backtester comment "모의투자 0.5초, 실전 0.05초 최소 간격 보장" (0.5 s paper, 0.05 s real) states the intent only.

Error handling
- EGW00201 means 초당 거래건수 초과 (per-second limit exceeded).
- README: paper accounts have lower REST limits.
- backtester/kis_backtest/providers/kis/data.py waits 61 s on EGW00201 and retries up to 3 times.

Portal system-wide caps
- inquire-balance (TTTC8434R) is capped at 120 TPS system-wide under the 원장 (ledger) policy, regardless of personal limits. Exceeding it returns "EGW00215 원장에서 허용 가능한 초당 거래건수를 초과하였습니다"; retry. A message without the word 원장 means the personal limit was exceeded.
- ETF 현재가 호가 is capped at 120 calls/s system-wide.
- 해외주식 상품기본정보 is blocked 08:59–09:31 (EGW00317).
- domestic_futureoption display_board_callput says at most 1 call/s.

Token issuance
- README: reissue at most once per minute.
- Portal: valid 24 h; a re-request within 6 h returns the same token.

Suggested client behaviour
- Keep total calls at or below about 10–20/s per appkey (0.1 s spacing is the conservative choice).
- Back off on EGW00201 (the official code waits 60 s) and retry on EGW00215.
caveats: No stock-account deposit/withdrawal history exists in the published API set. I grepped the repo and the 334-row MCP API catalog (MCP/KIS Code Assistant MCP/data.csv) and queried the portal search. The only published 입출금 ledger is OTFM3114R, which is for overseas futures accounts (08). The raw portal catalog, however, has an unpublished entry, 계좌입출금고거래내역 (CTRP6606R, /uapi/domestic-stock/v1/trading/inquire-deposit-withdrawal), with field names but no method, summary or example. Until it has been tried read-only, the app must take user-entered deposits/withdrawals or infer flows from snapshots.

The raw portal catalog has 427 entries. 343 have an HTTP method; 84 have none: fintech/partner/internal stubs, several with no fields at all. The stubs with no fields include 계좌기준일잔고조회 (inquire-balance-bsdate, balance as of a date), 원천징수내역조회 (withholding-tax-details) and 종합계좌계좌명조회 (inquire-account-name). They would help with historical balances, dividend tax and account names, but none is documented or confirmed callable. The earlier figure of '338 menu APIs' could not be reproduced.

No published historical balance API exists for domestic accounts. inquire-balance and inquire-account-balance are current-only, so the app must store its own periodic snapshots. Only overseas inquire-paymt-stdr-balance takes a BASS_DT.

inquire-balance arithmetic checks out on the portal sample: output2.tot_evlu_amt = scts_evlu_amt + prvs_rcdl_excc_amt (1759600 + 346455 = 2106055), and asst_icdc_amt = tot_evlu_amt - bfdy_tot_asst_evlu_amt (-36890). asst_icdc_erng_rt is 데이터 미제공 (not provided), and evlu_erng_rt is unused (always 0). That tot_evlu_amt excludes overseas stocks and FX is an inference; the portal does not say so.

inquire-account-balance checks out on the portal sample. tot_asst_amt equals the sum of the output1 rows: stocks 406000 + overseas stocks 185144504 + FX 1651434483743 + deposits 249855300 = 1651869889547. evlu_amt_smtl = domestic + overseas securities (185550504). nass_tot_amt equals evlu_amt_smtl in the sample, so it excludes FX and deposits; do not use it as net worth. Use tot_asst_amt as the account total.

inquire-account-balance output1 has no row labels. The portal lists 20 rows (IMA at row 3), but the 19-row sample fits the older order without IMA: overseas stocks are row 8 and FX row 16, not 9 and 17. Prefer the named output2 fields (tot_asst_amt, ovrs_stck_evlu_amt1, frcr_evlu_tota, dncl_amt, tot_dncl_amt) over row indices. The API is real-only, and its output2 is an object, not an array.

Adding totals across APIs double counts. inquire-account-balance.tot_asst_amt already includes overseas stocks, FX cash and the KRW deposit. Do not add inquire-balance.tot_evlu_amt or inquire-present-balance output3 on top of it.

In inquire-present-balance, frcr_evlu_amt2 means per-holding valuation in output1 but 출금가능원화금액 (withdrawable KRW) in output2. The repo chk_ COLUMN_MAPPING maps the key twice. With WCRC_FRCR_DVSN_CD=01, output1 amounts and prices are already in KRW (sample: 40 × 212277.756 = 8491110). FX valuation uses the day's 최초고시환율 (first posted rate), not the actual conversion rate. US trades after about 18:10 KST show up late unless the account has 애프터연장 (extended after-hours). The overseas stock service sign-up is required, and paper mode returns only output3.

period-rights (CTRGA011R) returns its rows under 'output', although the spec table says output1. The spec's rght_type_cd legend is 1-digit, but the sample returns 2-digit strings, so dividends are presumably '03' and special dividends '75'. rght_type_cd also lists 81–83 해외분배금 (overseas distributions), 84 DR FEE and 85 SECTION 871M, which suggests overseas events may appear in this domestic-tagged API. The spec gives RGHT_TYPE_CD only as blank; filter client-side.

The ksdinfo dividend divi_rate is a percentage of face value (per_sto_divi_amt / face_val), not a market dividend yield. Numbers are zero-padded strings, and divi_pay_dt uses 'YYYY/MM/DD'. For yield, compute the per-share dividend × quantity ÷ market value yourself.

해외주식 일별거래내역 (CTOS4001R, /uapi/overseas-stock/v1/trading/inquire-period-trans) lists buy/sell executions only (SLL_BUY_DVSN_CD 00/01/02). It is not a cash-flow or dividend ledger. 해외주식 권리종합 (HHDFS78330900, rights-by-ice) is also market-wide: record_dt, pay_dt, div_lock_dt and so on, with no account amounts.

Retirement pension accounts (ACNT_PRDT_CD 29) have their own endpoints:
- /uapi/domestic-stock/v1/trading/pension/inquire-balance (TTTC2208R; stocks/ETF/ETN only, no funds)
- /pension/inquire-present-balance (TTTC2202R)
- /pension/inquire-deposit (TTTC0506R)
All are real-only, and 55 (DC) accounts are not supported.

AFHR_FLPR_YN meaning differs between the portal (N = KRX close, X = NXT, Y = KRX+NXT combined) and the repo docstring (Y = after-hours single price). N is safe in both readings. INQR_DVSN: the portal lists only 01; the repo and official tools use 02 (by stock).
Every numeric value comes back as a string (e.g. "2106055", "40.00000000"). Success is rt_cd == "0"; errors carry msg_cd/msg1. The official _url_fetch treats any non-200 HTTP status as an error.

Token issuance sends a KakaoTalk alert every time. Cache the token on disk until access_token_token_expired, as the official read_token/save_token do. Do not reissue per run: the README limits reissue to once per minute, and the portal returns the same token within 6 h.
The paging sample in inquire-balance concatenates output2 from every page, which duplicates the summary row. Take output2 from a single page.
unresolved: Whether the unpublished 계좌입출금고거래내역 (CTRP6606R, /uapi/domestic-stock/v1/trading/inquire-deposit-withdrawal) can be called by an individual appkey, and with which HTTP method (probably GET). Its allowed request values (ACNT_TR_TYPE_CD, INQR_DVSN, etc.) and output semantics are undocumented. The only way to confirm is one read-only live call by the user.

The prod per-second limit per appkey: 20/s appears only in comments in the official repo's legacy scripts. No current portal page confirms it, the portal notice/FAQ pages are not reachable as JSON, and no official paper-trading number was found.

Whether period-rights (CTRGA011R) dividend rows carry the actual cash paid in last_alct_amt, and whether that figure is gross or net of tax_amt. The official sample has no dividend row. Also unconfirmed: which rght_cblc_type_cd (probably 10 현금입금) marks the payment, and the exact 2-digit rght_type_cd for dividends ('03' is inferred).

Whether CTRGA011R includes overseas-stock dividends received in the same 종합계좌. The rght_type_cd legend lists 81–83 해외분배금 and 85 SECTION 871M, which hints yes, but this is unverified. No other account-level API for overseas dividends received was found.
Meaning of nass_amt (inquire-balance; no portal description) and nass_tot_amt (inquire-account-balance; equals securities-only valuation in the sample).
The scope of tot_asst_amt in inquire-present-balance output3, and of tot_asst_amt2 in inquire-paymt-stdr-balance: overseas segment only, or including the KRW deposit.
Whether inquire-paymt-stdr-balance accepts past BASS_DT values (historical overseas snapshots), and how far back.
Whether inquire-balance and inquire-account-balance accept ACNT_PRDT_CD 22 (개인연금, personal pension). The portal documents pension-specific APIs only for 29.

Whether one appkey, which is bound to an HTS ID, can query every account (different CANO) under that HTS ID. The official sample uses one key with my_acct_stock and my_acct_future, but no document states the rule.
The error code returned for too-frequent token issuance (README: once per minute) was not found in the portal JSON or the repo.
Whether a paper-trading token (openapivts) follows the same 24 h / 6 h rules. The portal tokenP page does not distinguish.
